summaries.Good news: Today's uplifting stories celebrate human resilience and ingenuity—from a 91-year-old conquering the Appalachian Trail to a Kenyan startup creating robotic hands that translate speech into sign language for deaf students. These are moments where determination, compassion, and innovation solve real problems and expand possibility.
summaries.Ideas: The cultural conversation spans from AI's restructuring of work and expertise to memorial reflections on 9/11's legacy, with practical insights on leadership during uncertainty and warnings about AI deployment risks. Today's ideas grapple with how technology reshapes human systems and how we remember collective loss.
summaries.Technology: Breakthroughs in compact imaging, sustainable materials, and aerospace innovation compete with cautionary tales about water scarcity for chip manufacturing and the risks of rapid AI deployment. Today's tech stories oscillate between genuine progress and the infrastructure challenges that constrain it.
summaries.Design: From Japanese cedar-clad retreats embracing landscape privacy to robotic hands enabling deaf inclusion, today's design work balances aesthetic restraint with social purpose—while London's struggling creatives remind us that innovation thrives only where makers can afford to live.

items.title: AI isn’t replacing jobs; it’s restructuring work
